name: get_cross_repo_map
description: Return which indexed repos depend on which other indexed repos at the package level. Shows the full cross-repository dependency map based on package names extracted from manifest files (pyproject.toml, package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, etc.). Use to visualize how your indexed repos are interconnected. Pass repo to filter to a single repo's perspective.

repo.description: Optional repo ID to filter. If omitted, returns the full cross-repo map.
